name: emotecast
title: Emotecast
description: Search 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes and paste them as animated files at emoji or sticker size
author: Kan-A-Pesh

commands.name: search-emotes
commands.title: Search Emotes
commands.subtitle: Emotecast
commands.description: Search emotes and paste them at emoji or sticker size

preferences.name: showNsfw
preferences.title: NSFW Emotes
preferences.label: Include NSFW emotes (blurred until selected)
preferences.description: When enabled, NSFW emotes appear hidden and are revealed on selection

preferences.name: ffmpegPath
preferences.title: ffmpeg Path
preferences.description: Used to resize emotes that are not served at the exact target height. Leave empty to auto-detect.

preferences.name: magickPath
preferences.title: ImageMagick Path
preferences.description: Used to decode animated WebP emotes, which ffmpeg cannot read. Leave empty to auto-detect.

scripts.lint: biome lint src tests && ray lint
scripts.fix-lint: biome lint src tests --write && ray lint --fix
scripts.check: biome lint src tests && ray lint && vitest run && ray build -e dist
